nodes.title: Epic: Entity layer (persistence + provenance)
nodes.description: First-class persistence for entities (character/environment/prop/institution), attributes with provenance, relationships, and visual anchors. Source of truth for v1 worldbuilding system. Per Section 5.1.

nodes.title: Schema: entity_attributes / entity_relationships / visual_anchors tables
nodes.description: Net-new SQLite tables per Section 5.2. Additive migrations in api/lib/db/schema.js MIGRATIONS array; existing characters table is unaffected.

nodes.title: Migration: entities table + indexes
nodes.description: Add entities table (id PK, type CHECK in character/environment/prop/institution, name NOT NULL, created_at, updated_at). Indexes on type, name. Add to MIGRATIONS in api/lib/db/schema.js.

nodes.title: Migration: entity_attributes table with provenance CHECK
nodes.description: Add entity_attributes (id PK, entity_id FK, key, value, provenance NOT NULL CHECK in canon/inferred/suggested/temporary/derived, confidence REAL, source_stage INTEGER, superseded_by FK self, created_at). Indexes on entity_id, (entity_id, key), provenance.

nodes.title: Migration: entity_relationships table
nodes.description: Add entity_relationships (id PK, from_id FK, to_id FK, type, provenance CHECK, confidence, attributes JSON). Indexes on from_id, to_id, type.

nodes.title: Migration: visual_anchors table
nodes.description: Add visual_anchors (id PK, entity_id FK, type CHECK in reference_image/ipadapter_embedding/seed/prompt_anchor, payload BLOB, is_primary INTEGER, created_at). Index on entity_id, partial unique on (entity_id) WHERE is_primary=1.

nodes.title: Provenance enforcement (P0 hard prereq)
nodes.description: Section 9 names provenance bypass as the single highest-likelihood risk. DB constraint + single write helper + lint rule together close that risk before any extrapolation stage parser is allowed to write attributes.

nodes.title: Single attribute-write helper writeAttribute(db, …)
nodes.description: Implement writeAttribute(db, {entityId, key, value, provenance, confidence?, sourceStage?, supersedes?}) in api/lib/db/repositories.js. Only path that may INSERT into entity_attributes. Throws if provenance missing. Handles superseded_by chaining when supersedes is passed.

nodes.title: Lint/test rule blocking direct INSERT INTO entity_attributes
nodes.description: Vitest grep-based test that fails CI if any file outside repositories.js contains literal `INSERT INTO entity_attributes`. Cheap, prevents regression. Allowlist: the helper itself + tests.

nodes.title: Edit-promotes-to-canon: superseded_by chain
nodes.description: When user edits an inferred attribute, helper writes a new row provenance=canon and sets superseded_by → original row id. Original row stays for audit. Per Section 5.3.

nodes.title: Repository functions for entities/attrs/rels/anchors
nodes.description: Repository layer exposing typed CRUD for the new tables, following the pattern in api/lib/db/repositories.js (named function exports, no class).

nodes.title: Repo: createEntity/getEntity/listEntities/updateEntity/archiveEntity
nodes.description: Generalized entity CRUD (any type). archiveEntity sets archived_at; preserves history. listEntities supports filter by type.

nodes.title: Repo: getAttribute/listAttributes/promoteToCanon/dismissSuggested
nodes.description: Read-side queries (latest non-superseded per (entity_id, key) for inferred/canon). Mutations all delegate to writeAttribute. promoteToCanon = writeAttribute with provenance=canon supersedes=originalId. dismissSuggested marks via superseded_by → null payload row (or soft-delete column — pick one and document).

nodes.title: Repo: createRelationship/listRelationships/updateRelationship
nodes.description: Relationship CRUD. listRelationships supports filter by from_id, to_id, type prefix (e.g. 'family.*').

nodes.title: Repo: createVisualAnchor/listVisualAnchors/setPrimaryAnchor
nodes.description: Visual anchor CRUD. setPrimaryAnchor flips is_primary atomically (transaction): set 0 on previous primary, 1 on new. Enforces single primary per entity.

nodes.title: REST endpoints /entities/*
nodes.description: New Vercel-style serverless handlers in api/. Sit alongside existing /characters/* per Section 11 (additive, no migration of existing data).

nodes.title: API: POST/GET/PUT/DELETE /entities and /entities/:id
nodes.description: Standard CRUD handlers using the repo. Follows api/characters.js pattern (handler + try/finally runtime?.close).

nodes.title: API: attribute review actions (promote/dismiss/edit)
nodes.description: POST /entities/:id/attributes/:attrId/promote, /dismiss, /edit. Each delegates to writeAttribute via repo. Returns the new (or updated) attribute row.

nodes.title: API: /entities/:id/relationships CRUD
nodes.description: POST/GET/PUT/DELETE for relationships scoped to an entity.

nodes.title: API: /entities/:id/anchors CRUD + set-primary
nodes.description: POST/GET/DELETE anchors; POST /entities/:id/anchors/:anchorId/set-primary. Multipart upload accepted for type=reference_image.

nodes.title: Epic: Extrapolation pipeline (S1–S6)
nodes.description: Six-stage staged-LLM pipeline that turns sparse user notes into entities + canon/inferred attributes + relationships + visual descriptors + flagged conflicts. Per Section 6.

nodes.title: Pipeline orchestrator + cache + per-stage model routing
nodes.description: Stage contract, orchestrator runner, hash-keyed cache, and OQ1's stage→model routing seam (single-model default).

nodes.title: Stage contract / interface definition
nodes.description: Define a Stage = { id: 1..6, name, run({ entityId, db, llm, modelOverride, cache, prior }): Promise<{writes, suggestions, conflicts?, raw}> } interface in api/lib/extrapolation/types.js. Contract decision; no per-stage logic yet.

nodes.title: Stage cache: hash(input + stage + model) → result
nodes.description: Persistent cache keyed by sha256(canon-snapshot + stage_id + model_id). Hit returns prior raw + skip writes (writes are idempotent via writeAttribute, but we want the speed). Section 6.1 mitigation.

nodes.title: Sequential orchestrator (S1 → S2 → S3 → S4 → S5 → S6)
nodes.description: Orchestrator that runs stages in strict order, threads prior outputs to each stage, persists all writes via writeAttribute. Acceptable latency for MVP.

nodes.title: Parallelize S2–S5 given S1 (P1 optimization)
nodes.description: Per Section 6.1, S2–S5 are independent given S1. After sequential orchestrator works, parallelize via Promise.all. Keep sequential as fallback config flag.

nodes.title: Per-stage model routing seam (single-model default)
nodes.description: Config: stages.{1..6}.model with default 'auto' resolving to one provider/model. OQ1 decision: routing layer present, MVP runs single model. Per-stage tuning is a follow-up.

nodes.title: API: POST /extrapolate/character/:id and /extrapolate/stage/:id/:n
nodes.description: Two endpoints: full pipeline run (returns job id + streamed progress) and single-stage re-run (for review-driven UX). Stage 6 is a special re-run case.

nodes.title: Sub-epic Stage 1: Entity extraction
nodes.description: Parse sparse user input → entities + canon attributes. The seed for the rest of the pipeline.

nodes.title: S1 prompt template (sparse text → entities + canon attrs JSON)
nodes.description: Stable JSON-output prompt template. Output schema validated with Zod. Primary entity = canon; mentioned secondary entities = canon name only.

nodes.title: S1 parser → write entities + attrs via writeAttribute
nodes.description: Parse S1 LLM output, dedupe vs existing entities (slug match), insert canon attributes via writeAttribute (provenance=canon). Stage_source=1.

nodes.title: S1 fixture tests with Ruslan worked example
nodes.description: Fixture using Section 13 worked example. Asserts: 4 character entities + 2 environment + 1 institution emitted, ~12 canon attributes on Ruslan.

nodes.title: Sub-epic Stage 2: Historical/cultural enrichment
nodes.description: Era-specific clothing, objects, slang. Default low confidence per Section 9 risk row 4.

nodes.title: S2 prompt template (era/culture context → period-specific detail)
nodes.description: Reads canon era/setting attrs from S1; outputs period-specific clothing/objects/slang as JSON. Marked low-confidence by default.

nodes.title: S2 parser → inferred attrs (low confidence default)
nodes.description: Write attrs via writeAttribute provenance=inferred, confidence ≤0.6 unless source explicitly marks higher. Stage_source=2.

nodes.title: Sub-epic Stage 3: Psychological inference
nodes.description: Behavior, speech register, insecurities. Highest-risk for local-model quality (Risk row 7) — model routing seam exists for this reason.

nodes.title: S3 prompt template (canon + S2 → psychology)
nodes.description: Behavior tendencies, speech register, recurring fears/insecurities. JSON-structured output.

nodes.title: S3 parser → inferred attrs (psychology)
nodes.description: Write via writeAttribute. Stage_source=3. Keys prefixed with 'behavior.' / 'speech.' / 'fear.' for filtering.

nodes.title: Sub-epic Stage 4: Environmental projection
nodes.description: Likely spaces character inhabits + relationship-derived environmental signals. Spawns environment entities.

nodes.title: S4 prompt template (entity + canon + relationships → likely spaces)
nodes.description: Outputs proposed environment entities + relationship-derived detail (e.g. 'spends Fridays at beer hall with friends').

nodes.title: S4 parser → environment entities + attrs
nodes.description: Create environment entities (suggested provenance for new ones), write inferred attrs on the character. Stage_source=4.

nodes.title: S4: relationship-derived attrs with provenance=derived (OQ4)
nodes.description: Implements OQ4 decision: relationship-derived attrs are emitted with provenance=derived, key prefix 'relation.<type>:<other_slug>' (e.g. 'relation.romantic.crush:rita_vlasova'). Compiler will scope-gate inclusion.

nodes.title: Sub-epic Stage 5: Visual descriptor + anchor
nodes.description: Image-gen-ready visual descriptor + trigger primary anchor generation. Per Section 6 note, original Stage 7 'continuity locking' folds in here.

nodes.title: S5 prompt: descriptor optimized for IPAdapter + Qwen image gen
nodes.description: Visual descriptor consumable by buildPositivePrompt / IPAdapter pipeline. Includes face/body/wardrobe canonical phrasing for cross-shot consistency.

nodes.title: S5 parser → visual.descriptor attribute
nodes.description: Write descriptor as a single attribute key='visual.descriptor', provenance=inferred. Stage_source=5.

nodes.title: S5: trigger reference image generation
nodes.description: Final S5 step: enqueue reference render job via continuity layer (F_CONT_REFGEN). Persists generated image as primary visual_anchor.

nodes.title: Sub-epic Stage 6: Cross-stage consistency check
nodes.description: Reads S1–S5 outputs, surfaces conflicts. Section 6 calls this 'the single most likely failure mode'.

nodes.title: S6 prompt: detect conflicts across S1–S5 outputs
nodes.description: Reads collected stage outputs; emits structured conflicts list with contradiction text + offending attribute IDs.

nodes.title: S6 parser → suggested attrs flagged for review
nodes.description: Write conflict markers as provenance=suggested attrs with reference to conflicting attribute IDs in the value JSON. Stage_source=6.

nodes.title: API: resolve/dismiss S6 conflicts
nodes.description: POST /entities/:id/conflicts/:cid/{resolve,dismiss}. Resolve = pick winning attribute (other becomes superseded); dismiss = drop the conflict marker.

nodes.title: Epic: Visual continuity (IPAdapter strategy)
nodes.description: Per Section 7, MVP commits to option (a) IPAdapter + reference image. Identity must hold across 5 generations per the Done= criterion.

nodes.title: IPAdapter feasibility spike on Qwen-Image (P0 blocker)
nodes.description: Section 7 claims 'ComfyUI workflow already supports IPAdapter' — verified false against current Qwen-Image templates in api/lib/comfy/workflows/. Qwen is DiT-family; mainline IPAdapter targets SDXL. This spike must complete before committing F_CONT_INJECT work.

nodes.title: Research IPAdapter availability for Qwen-Image (DiT)
nodes.description: Identify available IPAdapter (or PuLID / InstantID equivalent) implementations for Qwen-Image in ComfyUI. List nodes, model files, license. Output: short doc.

nodes.title: Build minimal Qwen + IPAdapter end-to-end workflow
nodes.description: Modify a copy of qwen-image-2512-default.json to include the chosen IPAdapter loader/apply nodes. Run with a known reference image. Commit only the dev copy; production change comes later in T_C_INJECT_NODES.

nodes.title: Decision: continue (a) IPAdapter, escalate (b) LoRA earlier, or pivot?
nodes.description: Decision doc citing spike outcome. If feasibility is poor, propose a graph amendment (do not silently bypass) — the proposal Section 7 commits to (a).

nodes.title: Reference image generation (default + upload override)
nodes.description: OQ2 decision: generated by ComfyUI from S5 descriptors as default; user-upload as override. Generated path is MVP critical; upload override is P1.

nodes.title: Compile portrait prompt-pack from S5 visual.descriptor
nodes.description: Build a 'first portrait' prompt-pack: face-front view, neutral expression, plain backdrop, derived from visual.descriptor + canon facial attrs. Reuses qwenPromptCompiler patterns.

nodes.title: Enqueue reference render + persist as primary anchor
nodes.description: Wire portrait pack to comfyService, await result, persist image bytes via createVisualAnchor type=reference_image is_primary=1.

nodes.title: User-upload override path (OQ2 safety valve)
nodes.description: Multipart upload on /entities/:id/anchors; validates image; demotes existing primary; sets uploaded as primary. UI counterpart in T_F_ANCHOR_UPLOAD.

nodes.title: IPAdapter injection in workflow mapping
nodes.description: Update workflow templates + mapping schema + injectPromptPackIntoWorkflow to wire the primary visual_anchor as IPAdapter input at generation time.

nodes.title: Update production workflow templates with IPAdapter nodes
nodes.description: Apply spike outcome to qwen-image-2512-default.json (and -comfyui-00010.json). Estimate is 1d if spike was clean; flag for split if spike surfaced friction.

nodes.title: Extend mapping JSON schema: ipadapterImage, ipadapterStrength
nodes.description: Add optionalFields.ipadapterImage / optionalFields.ipadapterStrength to the .mapping.json files. Update validateWorkflowMapping accordingly.

nodes.title: Extend injectPromptPackIntoWorkflow to set IPAdapter image
nodes.description: When entity has primary visual_anchor and mapping.optionalFields.ipadapterImage exists, set it. If absent: skip (graceful fallback to text-only).

nodes.title: Cache CLIP-vision embedding from primary anchor (P1 perf)
nodes.description: Pre-compute CLIP-vision embedding once per anchor; persist as visual_anchor type=ipadapter_embedding. Re-renders skip image upload — see Section 13 'subsequent generations: ~30 seconds, no LLM calls'.

nodes.title: Continuity QA test (OQ5 acceptance)
nodes.description: OQ5 acceptance: Ruslan × 5 environments varying lighting+composition+TOD, blind-to-seed scoring, threshold ≥4 avg per axis (face/body/wardrobe).

nodes.title: Build QA test harness (5 env scenes, scoring sheet)
nodes.description: Define the 5 scene specs (each varies lighting × composition × time-of-day at minimum). Scoring sheet template. Documented in repo so it can be re-run on regression.

nodes.title: Generate the 5 outputs per harness
nodes.description: Run the 5 generations against the Ruslan worked example using the full pipeline + IPAdapter-injected workflow. Outputs saved + linked to entity_id.

nodes.title: Blind-seed scoring + acceptance decision
nodes.description: Reviewer scores face/body/wardrobe each 1–5 blind to seed. Pass = avg ≥4 per axis. Document outcome; if fail, propose graph amendment (likely escalate to (b) LoRA from F_DEFERRED).

nodes.title: Epic: Frontend (entity editor / attribute review / anchor picker)
nodes.description: Three new primary screens per Section 8. Review-and-approval interface, not 80-field form.

nodes.title: Entity editor screen
nodes.description: EntityEditor.jsx with type-aware sections. Canon edits create new canon rows (don't mutate).

nodes.title: EntityEditor.jsx shell + type-aware sections
nodes.description: Component shell, routing, section rendering for character/environment/prop/institution. Empty content; just structure.

nodes.title: Canon attribute view + inline edit
nodes.description: Display canon attrs grouped by key prefix; inline edit calls /entities/:id/attributes/:attrId/edit (which writes new canon row via repo helper, not mutate).

nodes.title: Audit trail UI: superseded_by chain (P1)
nodes.description: Per-attribute history viewer showing supersede chain. Polish — MVP can ship without it.

nodes.title: Attribute review panel
nodes.description: Approve/promote/edit/reject the per-attribute output of the pipeline. Per Section 8.

nodes.title: Inferred + suggested attrs list grouped by stage + key
nodes.description: Lists all non-canon, non-superseded attrs for an entity. Grouped by source_stage and key prefix. Shows confidence.

nodes.title: Promote / edit / dismiss / reject row actions
nodes.description: Wired to /entities/:id/attributes/:attrId/{promote,dismiss,edit}. Optimistic UI.

nodes.title: S6 conflicts surface + resolution UI (P1)
nodes.description: Dedicated conflicts pane reading suggested attrs with stage_source=6. MVP can resolve via API; UI surface is polish.

nodes.title: Visual anchor picker
nodes.description: Generate-or-upload chooser, gallery of past anchors, set-primary affordance.

nodes.title: Per-entity anchor gallery + set-primary action
nodes.description: Lists visual_anchors via /entities/:id/anchors. Star icon = primary; clicking star posts /set-primary.

nodes.title: Trigger 'Generate from S5 descriptor'
nodes.description: Button → POST /entities/:id/extrapolate/stage/5 (or refgen endpoint), polls until anchor appears, auto-promotes to primary if none was set.

nodes.title: Drop-zone upload override (P1)
nodes.description: Drop or browse → POST /entities/:id/anchors multipart. UI counterpart of T_C_REFGEN_UPLOAD.

nodes.title: Wire entity flow into existing UI
nodes.description: Navigation hooks from current CharacterBuilder / CastingPipelinePanel into the new screens.

nodes.title: Link from CharacterBuilder → EntityEditor
nodes.description: Existing characters get an 'Open as Entity' affordance that lifts the row into the new entity model (creates entities row referencing the same id; adds canon attrs from existing payload_json).

nodes.title: 'Run extrapolation' panel with progress + cancel
nodes.description: Calls /extrapolate/character/:id, streams stage progress (1/6 ... 6/6), cancel button. Result: review panel pre-populated.

nodes.title: Epic: Migration / integration
nodes.description: New endpoints sit alongside existing per Section 11; ChromaDB schema extension; docs.

nodes.title: Prompt-pack from-entity compiler
nodes.description: Bridges entity model → existing comfy pipeline. Implements OQ4 scope-gating for relationship-derived attrs.

nodes.title: Compile prompt-pack from canon + inferred attrs (single entity)
nodes.description: /promptpack/from-entity/:id. Pulls canon + non-superseded inferred attrs, calls extended buildPositivePrompt that knows the new attribute keys.

nodes.title: Add scope-aware relationship-derived attrs (OQ4)
nodes.description: Implements OQ4: derived attrs prefixed 'relation.<type>:<other_slug>' are included only when the other entity is in scope (passed in compile request). Prevents 'Ruslan solo shot' from leaking 'in love with Rita' tokens into the prompt.

nodes.title: Wire compiled pack to comfy queue with primary anchor
nodes.description: Glue: compile-from-entity → comfy-queue endpoint passes anchor image. Closes the loop: entity → pack → ComfyUI render with IPAdapter.

nodes.title: ChromaDB single-collection w/ entity_type metadata (OQ3)
nodes.description: OQ3 decision: one collection, filter on entity_type metadata. Extends current characterIndexing.js.

nodes.title: Generalize indexing: entity_type metadata field
nodes.description: Rename/augment characterIndexing.js → entityIndexing.js. Upsert metadata gains entity_type. queryByEmbedding accepts type filter.

nodes.title: One-shot reindex for existing characters → new metadata shape
nodes.description: Script under scripts/ that walks characters table and re-upserts with entity_type='character' metadata.

nodes.title: Docs update
nodes.description: Update PROJECT_CONTEXT.md / AGENT_HANDOFF.md / CLAUDE.md with new layers after MVP done.

nodes.title: Update PROJECT_CONTEXT / AGENT_HANDOFF / CLAUDE.md
nodes.description: Document new entity model, pipeline stages, IPAdapter strategy. Last task before deferring P2 work.

nodes.title: Epic: MVP acceptance (Section 4 'Done =')
nodes.description: Final gate. Closing this unblocks all P2 deferred items per the user's instruction.

nodes.title: Run full pipeline end-to-end on Ruslan example
nodes.description: Section 13 worked example: input the Ruslan paragraph, run pipeline, review attrs, generate primary anchor, compile from-entity pack. Verifies full happy path.

nodes.title: MVP 'Done =' gate met
nodes.description: All exit criteria met: 1 character + 1 environment, full pipeline, identity ≥4/5 face/body/wardrobe across 5 generations. Closing this issue is what unblocks P2.

nodes.title: Epic: Deferred / P2 (per Section 3 Non-Goals)
nodes.description: Explicit non-goals for v1. Issues exist so they don't get lost; all blocked-by T_ACC_MVP_DONE.

nodes.title: P2: Per-character LoRA training pipeline (Section 7 option b)
nodes.description: 90%+ visual fidelity vs ~70-80% with IPAdapter; weeks of work, GPU scheduling, storage management. Section 7 names this as the P2 upgrade for hero characters.

nodes.title: P2: Video generation
nodes.description: Section 3 non-goal.

nodes.title: P2: Multi-user collaboration / sharing
nodes.description: Section 3 non-goal. Local-first stays for v1.

nodes.title: P2: Graph database backend (when relationships outgrow FK model)
nodes.description: Section 3 non-goal; Section 9 risk row 6 says SQLite migration is acceptable at this scale. Revisit when relationship traversal complexity demands it.

nodes.title: P2: Cloud inference routing
nodes.description: Section 3 non-goal; consistent with current local-first direction.

nodes.title: P2: Auto-generated locations independent of characters
nodes.description: Section 3 non-goal: locations derive from character context in v1.

nodes.title: P2: Full historical fact-checking
nodes.description: Section 3 non-goal: low-confidence flag on Stage 2 outputs is acceptable for v1.
